prompt: A polished 3D isometric digital twin dashboard for a commercial spaceport mission control center. In the center, a futuristic launch pad features an orbital rocket venting white cryogenic steam, surrounded by lightning towers, spherical propellant storage tanks, and a moving crawler-transporter navigating marked access roads. Floating modern SaaS UI overlays surround the scene: a top telemetry bar with countdown timers and system health KPIs, floating interactive waypoint pins, a semi-transparent right-side inspector drawer showing rocket stage diagnostics, and a bottom horizontal countdown timeline. Clean minimal tech aesthetic, soft studio lighting, crisp data visualization elements, and subtle cinematic motion.
